description: Programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts, campaigns, reporting, and bidding strategies.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 (single-user or multi-user workflow) combined with a developer token to authorize API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a Google Cloud project and obtain a developer token, but standard production/real use requires navigating access levels and administrative/developer token approval.
api_notes: Comprehensive API surface covering account management, campaign creation, reporting via GAQL, billing, budgeting, and keyword planning.
mcp_notes: Google provides an official Google Ads MCP server as part of its developer toolkit.
rationale: While a broad public API and official MCP server exist, getting fully functional live credentials and production access requires developer token approval and access levels.

evidence.note: Describes OAuth 2.0 authentication workflows and developer token requirement.
Outlines getting started steps, project setup, and access levels.
Details the comprehensive Google Ads API reference and services.
Links to the Google Ads MCP server in the developer toolkit.
